program: Arkansas Department of Transportation economic-development road fund, $2M for improvements connecting the site to US 70 (AEDC-administered per Arkansas Leader)
issuer: Arkansas Department of Transportation / Arkansas Economic Development Commission (reported by KARK, Area Development, Arkansas Leader)
notes: News quoting the announcement (Dec 17 2020): 'The state is also investing $2 million through a fund created by the Arkansas Department of Transportation to improve roads around the future site' (KARK; Area Development: 'a fund ... that provides money for road improvements. It uses a portion of surplus the department receives in general revenue'). Arkansas Leader 2021-03-10 (paywalled after the first lines) says AEDC will pay $2M for road work near the facility and that Amazon will pay $400,000 for r[...]; its headline says 'gets $4 million' but the rest could not be read, so only $2M is recorded. Money pays for public road work, not a payment to Amazon. The AEDC release of the same date (saved) states no incentive. Arkansas Times (2020-10-14, 2020-12-17): Amazon, as a retailer, does not qualify for most Arkansas incentives; no tax abatement found. No primary ARDOT/AEDC award document located. program: AEDC contribution toward Fourche Dam Pike widening and other Port of Little Rock infrastructure (2020)
issuer: Arkansas Economic Development Commission (as reported by the Arkansas Democrat-Gazette)
notes: Unverified: the only evidence is a search-result snippet of the Democrat-Gazette (2020-07-10): 'The Arkansas Economic Development Commission's contribution of $1 million toward the widening of Fourche Dam Pike and other infrastructure improvements was cited by the Arkansas Commerce ...'; the article body is paywalled (saved page holds no text).
